name: Register a server-rendered block without JavaScript
query: Add a simple 'Average rating' block to the plugin. We don't have a JS build and don't want one.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Register the block on init with register_block_type(), a render_callback, and supports.autoRegister = true
Step 3: Use only string/number/integer/boolean attributes so controls are generated
Step 4: Escape output in the render callback and use get_block_wrapper_attributes()
Step 5: Note the WP 7.0 requirement (Requires at least) or guard for older versions
success_criteria: Block uses autoRegister with a render_callback
Hands off to wp-block-development if inner blocks or media controls are needed
